Package hadur2.core.policy

Class Matchup

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.policy.Matchup
public final class Matchup extends Object
MATCH-1: whether this battle's duel is one Hadur is already winning on the guns, read from the two battle-long hit rates DuelController keeps (POW-11).

The DrussGT route (D1 to D5) was built for the opponents 3.7 lost to, whose guns hit Hadur at least as often as Hadur hits them. Live, 3.8 gained on those and lost about 1.5 points a pairing on the field below the top 20 (docs/bench/live-3.8.md, docs/leak-38-plan.md). A won matchup is one where our rate's lower bound is above theirs' upper bound, each over at least 30 bullets. Against the top 10 our gun hits 5% to 8% and theirs 9% to 14%, so they never read as won; against the field below, ours is well above theirs within a round or two.

Once won, the reading holds until our lower bound falls to their raw rate, not just to their upper bound, so it does not flicker on each bullet near the line.

Before both sides have fired 30 bullets nothing is known and the matchup reads as open, so the route keeps its first-round behaviour (SHIELD-3's opening latch against DrussGT). Pure and stateless (DIAL-2).

      public static boolean won(Estimate ours, Estimate theirs, boolean wasWon)
      MATCH-1: whether the guns already favour us by more than both margins.
      Parameters:
      ours - our battle-long hit rate over all bullets
      theirs - the enemy's battle-long hit rate over all bullets
      wasWon - the reading before this one
      Returns:
      true when both rest on 30 bullets or more and our lower bound is above their upper bound (or, while already won, above their raw rate); false while either is unknown
